protocol.cost_basis: inherits source 10bps slippage/cost model; no turnover/fill telemetry so execution_cost_gate remains blocked
protocol.leaf_universe: strict_efficiency/relaxed_efficiency balanced/growth/aggressive leaf labels only; non-leaf token labels excluded
protocol.locked_oos_usage: report-only for current fold; grid itself is post-OOS research and not promotable
protocol.no_nested_rule: router consumes leaf rows only; no hybrid/router/meta rows as selection inputs

scale_modes.exact_unscaled: copies exact selected source or canonical strict-core fallback fold metrics
scale_modes.row_metric_scaled: linear row-level diagnostic approximation, not bar-exact; requires full bar rerun before trust

protocol.selection_inputs: current fold train/validation metrics plus prior completed source-leaf OOS returns only
